description: A lab-local information disclosure: the debug endpoint returns lab configuration including secret placeholders.

evidence.response: 200 OK, lab configuration with secret placeholders in the body
evidence.notes: Lab-local fixture traffic only; the values are lab placeholders, not real secrets

impact: Internal lab configuration is exposed to anyone who requests the debug endpoint.
proof_of_concept: GET /lab/debug returns 200 with the lab configuration document, including secret placeholders, in the response body.
remediation: Disable the debug endpoint outside the lab, and never return configuration values in responses.
steps_to_reproduce: Observe the configuration document in the response
title: Information disclosure in lab debug endpoint
